rationale: Fast 20-clip eval, cost-aware. Drops the most-expensive 40% per family by frames × (objs/frame)^1.5 (since tracker cost is O(N²) in objs/frame). Use with --frame-cap-sec and --workers for ~10-20s training-loop selection. Excludes MOT20-05 / MOT20-03 / PP22_00108 etc which dominate runtime.
